+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""HTTP health check collector for external server monitoring."""
+
+import time
+from typing import Dict, Any
+
+from collectors.system import SystemCollector
+from collectors.process import ProcessCollector
+
+class HttpHealthCollector:
+    """Collects HTTP health metrics from an external server."""
+
+    def __init__(self, target_host: str = "185.18.215.60", target_port: int = 80):
+        self.target_host = target_host
+        self.target_port = target_port
+        self.metrics = {
+            "http_server_status": 0,
+            "http_response_time_ms": 0,
+            "http_status_code": 0,
+            "last_check": 0,
+        }
+
+    def collect(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Collect health metrics from the target server."""
+        start = time.time()
+        try:
+            import requests
+            response = requests.get(
+                f"http://{self.target_host}:{self.target_port}",
+                timeout=10,
+            )
+            elapsed = (time.time() - start) * 1000
+            status = response.status_code
+            self.metrics["http_response_time_ms"] = round(elapsed, 2)
+            self.metrics["http_status_code"] = status
+            self.metrics["last_check"] = time.time()
+            return self.metrics
+        except Exception as e:
+            self.metrics["http_response_time_ms"] = 0
+            self.metrics["http_status_code"] = 0
+            self.metrics["last_check"] = time.time()
+            raise
+
+    def get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Get the latest collected metrics."""
+        return self.metrics.copy()
+
+
+# Initialize the collector
+HEALTH_COLLECTOR = HttpHealthCollector()
